verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a broad public API, OpenAPI spec, MCP server, and CLI that expose most core UI functions (events, insights, feature flags, experiments, SQL/HogQL, data warehouse, error tracking) to AI agents and scripts, going well beyond typical API coverage. However, there's no explicit claim/evidence of full 1:1 parity between API and UI, and a hands-on report shows a concrete gap: an attempt to create a cohort via SQL through PostHog's AI/LLM interface failed because 'a cohort cannot use a sql query,' contradicting a seamless API-equivalent experience. missing for 10: explicit documentation of full API-UI feature parity, and resolution of the cohort/SQL creation failure reported by users.
